note: shape id -> Unicode. 'unicode' is one character, or several where the drawing is a conjunct. 'confidence' is 1.0 for an exact drawing match against the reference font, 0.9 where the match was a ligature glyph of that font, lower where the reading was a convention. 'candidates' lists every reading of the same drawing. Empty 'unicode' means the reference font has no such drawing and the shape needs review.
